name: NeoGames
resolved_from: Found by fingerprinting the company's own careers page during the 2026-08-18 sweep: 'aristocrat/wd3/AristocratExternalCareersSite' (Workday tenant/host/site). The Israel locationCountry facet resolved to 084562884af243748dad7c84c304d89a and was confirmed by a live filtered call at import time.

api._note: *** OVERRIDES THE PLATFORM'S id MAPPING, AND IT IS LOAD-BEARING. *** _platforms/workday.json maps id to bulletFields.0 because that is the requisition id on every other tenant - verified live 2026-08-20 across all 11 Workday companies: autodesk '26WD97479', crowdstrike 'R29093', digital_turbine 'JR101044', mks_instruments 'R21779', palo_alto_networks 'JR-020552'. bulletFields is a positional array with no schema, and on THIS tenant it is ordered differently: ['Regular', 'Tel Aviv District', 'Israel', 'R0021963', 'Aristocrat'] - index 0 is the EMPLOYMENT TYPE and the requisition id is second from the END. Every posting on the board is 'Regular', so every posting collapsed onto one key. Measured on 2026-08-20: the live fetch returned 2 Israel-relevant postings and 1 distinct id, and state held a single entry keyed 'Regular' whose title was 'Bookkeeper' - which roles.py correctly blocks. So the collision was hiding this board's on-family postings ('Games Product Manager') PERMANENTLY, not merely delaying them: the diff runs on Job.id, so a posting whose id is already seen can never be new again. Nothing else could see it - last_count stayed at 2, above zero and stable, so the health gate never fired and never would. It was found by src/health_report.py comparing last_count against len(jobs), an invariant that must hold on a healthy run and that nothing had ever checked. neogames is the ONLY one of the 11 with this ordering, which is why this is a per-company override and not a platform change. *** Why -2 and not 3, measured 2026-08-20 on the full board. *** The district element is ABSENT for a location whose Workday hierarchy has no state/province level, so the array is 4 long there, not 5: ['Regular', 'United Kingdom', 'R0020949', 'Aristocrat']. Across the 168 distinct postings on this tenant, 27 are that shape, and on every one of them index 3 reads the BRAND - 'Aristocrat', 'Aristocrat Gaming', 'Aristocrat Interactive', 'Product Madness'. Index 3 is therefore requisition-shaped on 141 of 168 and yields only 145 distinct ids: the SAME silent collision this override was written to fix, one posting shape away. Index -2 is requisition-shaped on 168 of 168 and fully distinct, because the brand is always last. It makes no difference to what the bot fetches today - every Israeli posting carries 'Tel Aviv District' and both indexes resolve to the same id - and that is exactly why it is worth pinning: the failure mode here is silence, so the index to keep is the one that survives the whole board rather than the one that survives today's two postings.

health._note: Live-verified on 2026-08-19: 3 Israel-relevant postings. expected_min_jobs=0 is a deliberately conservative floor (about 25% of what was observed), because this half of the health gate exists for slow decay over months - sudden breakage is caught by the relative-collapse check in state.py, which needs no number here. No absolute floor is set: below 12 postings a floor causes more false alarms than it catches, and a drop to zero is already covered by the total-zero check.
